name: Kavyanjali
description: Established in 2014, KIET-Kavyanjali stands as a beacon of literary excellence within KIET, dedicated to fostering a vibrant multilingual literary culture among its student body. Through a variety of events and initiatives, KIET-Kavyanjali strives to keep the flame of literature burning brightly, providing a stage for budding talents to showcase their creativity and vast thinking. From Kavi-Sammelans to online poetry competitions, the club has become an integral part of campus life, attracting both renowned poets and emerging wordsmiths alike, with a focus on languages like Hindi and Urdu.

achievements.title: Inter-Institutional Success
achievements.desc: Kavyanjali members secured top positions at prestigious fests, including Rishit Singh winning 1st place at Melange'25 (IMS Ghaziabad) and Dev Tyagi securing 1st place at Confluence 2K25 (NIT Kurukshetra).

achievements.title: Regional Literary Excellence
achievements.desc: The club achieved significant recognition at premier regional events like Mridang'25 at ABES Ghaziabad, where Aditya Shivhare earned the 2nd Runner-Up position among top institutions from Delhi-NCR.

achievements.title: Platform for Emerging Talent
achievements.desc: Established inclusive open-mic sessions through Kavya-Dhara, providing a dedicated stage for over 45 budding poets to express creativity and engage with the literary community.

events.title: Kavi Sammelan @ Epoque
events.desc: A grand literary celebration held on Apr 03, 2026, featuring renowned poets like Kushal Dauneria and Sarvesh Asthana, focusing on the rich tradition of Hindi literature.

events.title: Kavya-Dhara
events.desc: A multi-level cultural event showcasing a tapestry of poetry, shayari, and spoken word to foster a vibrant campus literary culture, hosted at the KIET CRPC Hall.

events.title: Mridang '25 Participation
events.desc: A high-caliber poetry slam held on Nov 10, 2025, themed around 'Navras,' where members interpreted fundamental human emotions through performance poetry.
